name: PolyPDF browser tools

tools.name: polypdf_merge_pdf

tools.description: Combine two or more PDFs into a single file. Add your files, arrange them, and save a new PDF. Interactive forms are flattened in the combined copy; document bookmarks and signatures are not preserved.
